nodes.goal: Load Back Bay and the Chicago Loop from the repository's extracts, each into a workspace of its own; add up each road's minutes of sun on the June solstice with a WGSL shader, each area at its own latitude and longitude; draw a map of each area's roads colored by their sun, over the area's buildings, with a histogram of its roads' minutes of sun under it, each histogram linked to its map's roads.
nodes.content:
{
  "layout": {
    "type": "grid",
    "columns": 2,
    "gap": 8
  },
  "data": [
    {
      "type": "osm",
      "pbfFileUrl": "docs/examples/data/back_bay.osm.pbf",
      "queryArea": {
        "geocodeArea": "Boston",
        "areas": [
          "Back Bay"
        ]
      },
      "outputTableName": "back_bay",
      "autoLoadLayers": {
        "layers": [
          "surface",
          "parks",
          "water",
          "roads",
          "buildings"
        ]
      },
      "workspace": "boston"
    },
    {
      "type": "osm",
      "pbfFileUrl": "docs/examples/data/chicago_loop.osm.pbf",
      "queryArea": {
        "geocodeArea": "Chicago",
        "areas": [
          "Loop"
        ]
      },
      "outputTableName": "loop",
      "autoLoadLayers": {
        "layers": [
          "surface",
          "parks",
          "water",
          "roads",
          "buildings"
        ]
      },
      "workspace": "chicago"
    }
  ],
  "compute": [
    {
      "dataRef": "back_bay_roads",
      "workspace": "boston",
      "attributes": {
        "seg": "geometry.coordinates"
      },
      "attributeMatrices": {
        "seg": {
          "rows": "auto",
          "cols": 2
        }
      },
      "uniforms": {
        "bld_height": {
          "fromFeature": {
            "layer": "back_bay_buildings",
            "iterate": "batched",
            "path": "properties.height",
            "required": true
          }
        },
        "doy": 172
      },
      "uniformMatrices": {
        "ring": {
          "fromFeature": {
            "layer": "back_bay_buildings",
            "iterate": "batched",
            "path": "geometry.coordinates.0"
          },
          "cols": 2
        }
      },
      "outputColumnName": "sunlight",
      "outputTableName": "back_bay_road_sun",
      "layerType": "roads",
      "wgslFunction": [
        "let pi      = 3.14159265359;",
        "let lat_rad = 0.7393;",
        "let lon_ref = -75.0;",
        "let lon_loc = -71.06;",
        "",
        "let dec_rad = -0.40928 * cos(2.0 * pi / 365.0 * (doy + 10.0));",
        "",
        "let ax = seg[0u]; let ay = seg[1u];",
        "let bx = seg[2u]; let by = seg[3u];",
        "",
        "let n_buildings: u32 = u32(num_features);",
        "",
        "var sunlight: f32 = 0.0;",
        "for (var hour = 7i; hour <= 19i; hour++) {",
        "    let solar_time = f32(hour) + (lon_ref - lon_loc) / 15.0;",
        "    let h_rad = (solar_time - 12.0) * pi / 12.0;",
        "    let sin_alt = sin(lat_rad) * sin(dec_rad) + cos(lat_rad) * cos(dec_rad) * cos(h_rad);",
        "    let alt_rad = asin(clamp(sin_alt, -1.0, 1.0));",
        "    if alt_rad <= 0.0 { continue; }",
        "",
        "    let az_rad = atan2(sin(h_rad), sin(lat_rad) * cos(h_rad) - cos(lat_rad) * tan(dec_rad)) + pi;",
        "    let sdx = -sin(az_rad);",
        "    let sdy = -cos(az_rad);",
        "    let perp_x = sdy;",
        "    let perp_y = -sdx;",
        "",
        "    let au = ax * perp_x + ay * perp_y;",
        "    let av = ax * sdx + ay * sdy;",
        "    let bu = bx * perp_x + by * perp_y;",
        "    let bv = bx * sdx + by * sdy;",
        "",
        "    var any_hit = false;",
        "    for (var bi = 0u; bi < n_buildings; bi++) {",
        "        let height = bld_height[bi];",
        "        let shadow_len = height / tan(alt_rad);",
        "        let base = bi * 8u;",
        "",
        "        var u_lo: f32 =  1e30; var u_hi: f32 = -1e30;",
        "        var v_lo: f32 =  1e30; var v_hi: f32 = -1e30;",
        "        for (var ci = 0u; ci < 4u; ci++) {",
        "            let rx = ring[base + ci * 2u];",
        "            let ry = ring[base + ci * 2u + 1u];",
        "            let ru = rx * perp_x + ry * perp_y;",
        "            let rv = rx * sdx + ry * sdy;",
        "            u_lo = min(u_lo, ru); u_hi = max(u_hi, ru);",
        "            v_lo = min(v_lo, rv); v_hi = max(v_hi, rv);",
        "        }",
        "        let v_hi_shadow = v_hi + shadow_len;",
        "",
        "        var hit = false;",
        "        if au >= u_lo && au <= u_hi && av >= v_lo && av <= v_hi_shadow { hit = true; }",
        "        else if bu >= u_lo && bu <= u_hi && bv >= v_lo && bv <= v_hi_shadow { hit = true; }",
        "        else if !(max(au, bu) < u_lo || min(au, bu) > u_hi) &&",
        "                !(max(av, bv) < v_lo || min(av, bv) > v_hi_shadow) {",
        "            let du = bu - au;",
        "            let dv = bv - av;",
        "            if abs(du) > 0.001 {",
        "                let t0 = (u_lo - au) / du;",
        "                let t1 = (u_hi - au) / du;",
        "                let t_enter = max(min(t0, t1), 0.0);",
        "                let t_exit  = min(max(t0, t1), 1.0);",
        "                if t_enter <= t_exit {",
        "                    let v_enter = av + t_enter * dv;",
        "                    let v_exit  = av + t_exit  * dv;",
        "                    if max(v_enter, v_exit) >= v_lo && min(v_enter, v_exit) <= v_hi_shadow {",
        "                        hit = true;",
        "                    }",
        "                }",
        "            } else {",
        "                if max(av, bv) >= v_lo && min(av, bv) <= v_hi_shadow { hit = true; }",
        "            }",
        "        }",
        "        if hit { any_hit = true; break; }",
        "    }",
        "",
        "    if !any_hit { sunlight += 60.0; }",
        "}",
        "",
        "return sunlight;"
      ]
    },
    {
      "dataRef": "loop_roads",
      "workspace": "chicago",
      "attributes": {
        "seg": "geometry.coordinates"
      },
      "attributeMatrices": {
        "seg": {
          "rows": "auto",
          "cols": 2
        }
      },
      "uniforms": {
        "bld_height": {
          "fromFeature": {
            "layer": "loop_buildings",
            "iterate": "batched",
            "path": "properties.height",
            "required": true
          }
        },
        "doy": 172
      },
      "uniformMatrices": {
        "ring": {
          "fromFeature": {
            "layer": "loop_buildings",
            "iterate": "batched",
            "path": "geometry.coordinates.0"
          },
          "cols": 2
        }
      },
      "outputColumnName": "sunlight",
      "outputTableName": "loop_road_sun",
      "layerType": "roads",
      "wgslFunction": [
        "let pi      = 3.14159265359;",
        "let lat_rad = 0.73027;",
        "let lon_ref = -75.0;",
        "let lon_loc = -87.65;",
        "",
        "let dec_rad = -0.40928 * cos(2.0 * pi / 365.0 * (doy + 10.0));",
        "",
        "let ax = seg[0u]; let ay = seg[1u];",
        "let bx = seg[2u]; let by = seg[3u];",
        "",
        "let n_buildings: u32 = u32(num_features);",
        "",
        "var sunlight: f32 = 0.0;",
        "for (var hour = 7i; hour <= 19i; hour++) {",
        "    let solar_time = f32(hour) + (lon_ref - lon_loc) / 15.0;",
        "    let h_rad = (solar_time - 12.0) * pi / 12.0;",
        "    let sin_alt = sin(lat_rad) * sin(dec_rad) + cos(lat_rad) * cos(dec_rad) * cos(h_rad);",
        "    let alt_rad = asin(clamp(sin_alt, -1.0, 1.0));",
        "    if alt_rad <= 0.0 { continue; }",
        "",
        "    let az_rad = atan2(sin(h_rad), sin(lat_rad) * cos(h_rad) - cos(lat_rad) * tan(dec_rad)) + pi;",
        "    let sdx = -sin(az_rad);",
        "    let sdy = -cos(az_rad);",
        "    let perp_x = sdy;",
        "    let perp_y = -sdx;",
        "",
        "    let au = ax * perp_x + ay * perp_y;",
        "    let av = ax * sdx + ay * sdy;",
        "    let bu = bx * perp_x + by * perp_y;",
        "    let bv = bx * sdx + by * sdy;",
        "",
        "    var any_hit = false;",
        "    for (var bi = 0u; bi < n_buildings; bi++) {",
        "        let height = bld_height[bi];",
        "        let shadow_len = height / tan(alt_rad);",
        "        let base = bi * 8u;",
        "",
        "        var u_lo: f32 =  1e30; var u_hi: f32 = -1e30;",
        "        var v_lo: f32 =  1e30; var v_hi: f32 = -1e30;",
        "        for (var ci = 0u; ci < 4u; ci++) {",
        "            let rx = ring[base + ci * 2u];",
        "            let ry = ring[base + ci * 2u + 1u];",
        "            let ru = rx * perp_x + ry * perp_y;",
        "            let rv = rx * sdx + ry * sdy;",
        "            u_lo = min(u_lo, ru); u_hi = max(u_hi, ru);",
        "            v_lo = min(v_lo, rv); v_hi = max(v_hi, rv);",
        "        }",
        "        let v_hi_shadow = v_hi + shadow_len;",
        "",
        "        var hit = false;",
        "        if au >= u_lo && au <= u_hi && av >= v_lo && av <= v_hi_shadow { hit = true; }",
        "        else if bu >= u_lo && bu <= u_hi && bv >= v_lo && bv <= v_hi_shadow { hit = true; }",
        "        else if !(max(au, bu) < u_lo || min(au, bu) > u_hi) &&",
        "                !(max(av, bv) < v_lo || min(av, bv) > v_hi_shadow) {",
        "            let du = bu - au;",
        "            let dv = bv - av;",
        "            if abs(du) > 0.001 {",
        "                let t0 = (u_lo - au) / du;",
        "                let t1 = (u_hi - au) / du;",
        "                let t_enter = max(min(t0, t1), 0.0);",
        "                let t_exit  = min(max(t0, t1), 1.0);",
        "                if t_enter <= t_exit {",
        "                    let v_enter = av + t_enter * dv;",
        "                    let v_exit  = av + t_exit  * dv;",
        "                    if max(v_enter, v_exit) >= v_lo && min(v_enter, v_exit) <= v_hi_shadow {",
        "                        hit = true;",
        "                    }",
        "                }",
        "            } else {",
        "                if max(av, bv) >= v_lo && min(av, bv) <= v_hi_shadow { hit = true; }",
        "            }",
        "        }",
        "        if hit { any_hit = true; break; }",
        "    }",
        "",
        "    if !any_hit { sunlight += 60.0; }",
        "}",
        "",
        "return sunlight;"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "map": [
    {
      "id": "back_bay",
      "workspace": "boston",
      "layerRefs": [
        {
          "dataRef": "back_bay_surface"
        },
        {
          "dataRef": "back_bay_parks"
        },
        {
          "dataRef": "back_bay_water"
        },
        {
          "dataRef": "back_bay_buildings"
        },
        {
          "dataRef": "back_bay_road_sun",
          "isPick": true,
          "isColorMap": true,
          "getFnv": "sunlight",
          "getFnvType": "quantitative",
          "colorMapRange": [
            0,
            780
          ],
          "defaultFnv": 0,
          "title": "Back Bay: sun (minutes)"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "loop",
      "workspace": "chicago",
      "layerRefs": [
        {
          "dataRef": "loop_surface"
        },
        {
          "dataRef": "loop_parks"
        },
        {
          "dataRef": "loop_water"
        },
        {
          "dataRef": "loop_buildings"
        },
        {
          "dataRef": "loop_road_sun",
          "isPick": true,
          "isColorMap": true,
          "getFnv": "sunlight",
          "getFnvType": "quantitative",
          "colorMapRange": [
            0,
            780
          ],
          "defaultFnv": 0,
          "title": "Loop: sun (minutes)"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "plot": [
    {
      "id": "back_bay_sun",
      "workspace": "boston",
      "dataRef": "back_bay_road_sun",
      "mark": "bar",
      "axis": [
        "sunlight",
        "@transform"
      ],
      "title": "Back Bay: roads by minutes of sun",
      "transform": {
        "preset": "binning-1d",
        "options": {
          "bins": 13
        }
      },
      "events": [
        "brushX"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "loop_sun",
      "workspace": "chicago",
      "dataRef": "loop_road_sun",
      "mark": "bar",
      "axis": [
        "sunlight",
        "@transform"
      ],
      "title": "Loop: roads by minutes of sun",
      "transform": {
        "preset": "binning-1d",
        "options": {
          "bins": 13
        }
      },
      "events": [
        "brushX"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "links": [
    {

      "target": "back_bay"
    },
    {

dataflow.name: Autark: Back Bay or the Loop, whose streets get more sun at the solstice
dataflow.description: One Autark node loads Back Bay and the Chicago Loop from local .pbf files into two workspaces, adds up each road's minutes of sun on the June solstice with a WGSL shader on the GPU, each area at its own latitude and longitude, and draws four views arranged by its layout: a map of each area's roads colored by their minutes of sun, and under each a histogram of its roads' minutes of sun, linked to its map's roads, so brushing bars lights those roads.
dataflow.task: Compare how much sun the streets of Back Bay and of the Chicago Loop get on the June solstice.
